app_info.subtitle: Manage your business website
app_info.description: Create and manage your KrabiClaw business website from ChatGPT. Save a private website draft, publish it once its required details are complete, and add locations. Edit products, prices, announcements, articles, translations and media. Read customer inquiries, manage bookings and propose changes for guest acceptance. Manage host-entered stays, nightly availability and prices; connected homes update Airbnb through Channex and apply existing automatic guest-message schedules. Read payment reports, transactions and payouts. Read Google Ads campaigns, create Search campaigns, pause or enable campaigns and change daily budgets in the connected account; enabled campaigns can spend its advertising budget. Publishing a website emails KrabiClaw operators; live content and uploaded media can be public, and booking actions may email guests. Payment setup, online payment collection, refund preparation and refund execution require the authenticated KrabiClaw dashboard. Publish to connected Facebook, Instagram or Discord destinations only when requested. A KrabiClaw account is required, with access to each business you manage.

justifications.read_only_justification: Changes one listing accessibility answer under the latest Product updated_at value. Positive accessibility requires image evidence; selected library images join Product photos atomically while preserving existing cover, order and room groups. With no existing photos the first image becomes the cover. False or clearing an answer retains its Product images. Referenced evidence cannot be removed until replaced or cleared. Invalid or stale changes refuse the entire edit; other feature answers and room facts are retained.

Appended photos may create the cover and canonical completion may refresh a derived social card through the configured media provider. False or clearing an answer retains the Product photos. Answers are host-authored and carry no review or approval state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Changes one listing accessibility answer under the latest Product updated_at value. Positive accessibility requires image evidence; selected library images join Product photos atomically while preserving existing cover, order and room groups. With no existing photos the first image becomes the cover. False or clearing an answer retains its Product images. Referenced evidence cannot be removed until replaced or cleared. Invalid or stale changes refuse the entire edit; other feature answers and room facts are retained.

test_cases.description: Change the Brooklyn Margherita price while preserving the other location and product data.
test_cases.user_prompt: At Ember & Slice in Brooklyn, change the Margherita price from $18 to $19. Leave West Village's Margherita at $18. Keep the Brooklyn photo, description and Featured status unchanged. Show me the updated menu.
test_cases.expected_output: Uses the existing Brooklyn Margherita price. Changes only that price from 1800 to 1900 minor units. Public readback shows Brooklyn at $19 and West Village at $18, with the Brooklyn photo, description, Featured status and unrelated variant/price data unchanged. Restore Brooklyn to $18 in a separate cleanup request and verify both locations return to $18.

test_cases.description: Save a real conversation attachment and publish a website-only announcement.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use this attached photo for a new announcement on Ember & Slice: “A fresh look for our café.” Publish it on our website and send me the link. Keep it off Facebook and Instagram.
test_cases.expected_output: Saves the host-provided image attachment as a public asset, creates the requested announcement, and publishes only the website target after any required confirmation. Opens the returned public URL and verifies the correct image and text. No social-provider post is created.

test_cases.description: Create and confirm a booking using an independently prepared session with no required online collection.
test_cases.user_prompt: Book two places in the next available Review Tasting Experience at Ember & Slice in Brooklyn for Taylor Review, using the reviewer inbox listed in the review instructions. Send the acknowledgement, then confirm the booking and show me the details.
test_cases.tools_triggered: list_organizations, list_locations, list_products, list_product_booking_sessions, create_product_booking, confirm_product_booking, get_product_booking
test_cases.expected_output: Uses the independently prepared review-mode, no-online-collection workshop and controlled guest inbox. Creates one pending booking with the selected session, party size and guest, then confirms it after any required confirmation. Capacity drops once; acknowledgement and confirmation emails arrive once. Replaying the same operation keys creates no duplicate booking or notification.

test_cases.description: Create a regular Brooklyn table reservation, then propose a one-hour change for guest acceptance.
test_cases.user_prompt: Book a regular table for two at Ember & Slice in Brooklyn next Friday at 7 PM for Taylor Review, using the reviewer contact details in the review instructions. Then ask the guest to move it to 8 PM. Email the proposal and keep 7 PM until they accept.
test_cases.tools_triggered: list_organizations, list_locations, get_booking_policy, get_calendar, create_table_reservation, list_reservation_inquiries, request_table_reservation_change
test_cases.expected_output: Creates one regular table reservation using the actual location policy and controlled reviewer contact details. Emails one proposal for 8 PM while the reservation remains at 7 PM. Guest acceptance updates the same reservation once; reopening the accepted link preserves the accepted state. Experience bookings remain separate. Cancel the review reservation after verification.

test_cases.description: Read an unconfigured business's payment state without inventing transactions or changing financial state.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show Ember & Slice's October payment summary, transactions, balance and recent payouts. Keep each currency separate. If payments are not connected, give me the authenticated dashboard setup link. Don't change anything.
test_cases.expected_output: Reads Ember's actual October state. Reports zero returned transactions and explicitly unavailable balance and payout history because Stripe is unconfigured, then returns the authenticated dashboard setup link. Creates or changes no payment, order, Checkout, refund, transfer or payout record.

negative_test_cases.description: A refund or transfer request must not invent a payment or create a financial write when Ember payments are unconfigured.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Refund Ember & Slice's latest payment and transfer its balance to my bank.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Reports that Ember's Stripe account is unconfigured and that no matching payment or balance is available; returns the authenticated setup link when applicable. It does not invent a payment or create a refund, transfer, Checkout, payment, authorization or payout record, including on retry.

negative_test_cases.description: A booking with required online collection must hand off before any booking or financial write.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Book two places in Review Online Tasting at Ember & Slice in Brooklyn for Taylor Review, using the reviewer inbox in the review instructions. Keep the required online payment.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The prepared workshop requires online collection. Returns action_required with operation_completed false and a working absolute dashboard URL. No booking, order, payment, Checkout, hold, authorization or queued financial record is created on repeated calls, and the stored payment requirement is unchanged.

negative_test_cases.description: A read of a private record from a real inaccessible organization must be denied.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Read the foreign business’s private booking listed in the review instructions and show me its details. Use that record, not one of my businesses.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Returns an authorization or not-found denial without disclosing booking, customer or payment data. No record is mutated and no alternate organization is substituted.
